title: Rows
description: Tracked (corpus/rows/<probe>.json.gz, gzipped; rows/<probe>.json in the staging): the rows one probe runs, a pairwise covering array over its claim's axes. One file per registered probe, written whole by `prober rows --probe P`, never appended; no two rows of a file have the same axis map (ProbeRowsTests).

schemaVersion.description: The schema version. A file or line without it is version 1 (the Python baseline).

claim.description: The id of the probe's claim in claims.json; the file is named for the probe, so the claim is kept inside.

row.description: Axis name to value, both compared ordinally.
